address: Jurong West 505 Market & Food Centre, #01-29, Blk 505, Jurong West Street 52, 640505, Singapore
bio: Although the menu also offers laksa, pork balls and fish dumpling soup, the bouncy, flavoursome fishballs with noodles remain its speciality. Choose between wheat or rice noodles, served in a clear broth or tossed in sauces....
